title: automate KMS/HSM TLS rotation and secrets integration for private-installer, helm and terraform
author: Diego Morales
description: Motivation: private deployments must support automated TLS certificate rotation, KMS/HSM-backed key material, and a predictable secrets flow (sealed-secrets + Vault) so upgrades and long-lived clusters do not require manual intervention. This PR implements a coordinated solution across the private-installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules to automate TLS rotation and integrate KMS/HSM keys for sealing/unsealing and TLS cert signing. Summary of changes and approach: 1) private-installer: add rotation controller and operator hooks that watch Vault/SealedSecrets keys and trigger rolling restarts for affected services when certs/keys change. The controller supports pluggable backends: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and PKCS#11 HSM providers. 2) Helm charts: new chart values for keyProvider (none|aws|gcp|hsm), hsm config (slot, lib path, token path), and rotation policy (interval, jitter, gracePeriod). Templates include post-install hooks that register rotation cronjobs in the cluster and create RBAC rules. 3) Terraform modules: updated kms module to expose key rotation IAM bindings and a new hsm module that produces the required PKCS#11 bootstrap artifacts (connector secrets) and optional HSM attestation outputs. 4) Sealed-Secrets/Vault integration: operator bootstrap recipe that either hands off to sealed-secrets with KMS-wrapped private keys or uses Vault PKI to issue short-lived certificates; migration helpers included for clusters currently using static certs. 5) Upgrade/rollback tooling: installer includes upgrade plan generation that previews which workloads will restart as a result of rotation and a rollback hook that can restore pinned cert versions stored in a secure secrets bucket. 6) Tests: e2e test harness and CI scenarios to validate rotation path with a mock HSM and with Vault in dev mode. Checklist implemented in PR description: - [x] Controller for cert/key rotation added to private-installer - [x] Helm chart values and templates updated - [x] Terraform modules updated for KMS/HSM provisioning - [x] Migration and rollback scripts added - [x] e2e tests and CI integration added - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes included Key implementation notes: - The rotation controller watches configured Secret names and annotated resources; it performs a safe drain-and-restart for stateful agents (ingress, sidecars) and a rolling restart for stateless services. - HSM integration uses a PKCS#11 shim. The installer now supports optional provisioning of an HSM connector secret that references a CSR attestation flow; actual HSM PIN/credential management is left to cluster operators and to Terraform outputs when possible. - For sealed-secrets we prefer KMS-wrapped private keys. When operators select Vault PKI, the controller requests short-lived certs via Vault's role bindings; Vault auth can be via K8s service-account JWT or via KMS-wrapped AppRole depending on operator preference. - Migration path: a one-time migration job can re-wrap existing static TLS private keys into sealed-secrets using the selected KMS provider; a safety window preserves previous certs for rollback. - Rollback: pinned-cert artifacts are stored in an encrypted S3 bucket (Terraform-managed) with a one-click restore script in the installer. - Security: minimal plaintext key exposure; audit events emitted when rotation occurs and when operator-initiated re-wraps happen. Releases and upgrade notes included in PR mention operators must grant KMS permissions for encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify where applicable. Testing and validation: - Local dev: 'make dev-rotation' runs the controller against a dev Vault instance and a pkcs11 mock to validate HSM paths. - CI: new pipeline stage 'rotation-integration' runs e2e with mocked KMS/HSM providers and fails loudly on any certificate expiry/regeneration regressions. - Staging: rollout validated in staging clusters with a canary policy that rotates one ingress at a time. Rollout strategy: default rotation policy is conservative (30d interval, 10% jitter, 5m grace). Operators can tune per-cluster via Helm values or with Terraform variables. Migration instructions and troubleshooting guidance are included in docs/upgrade/rotation.md. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless operator opts in to automated rotation or selects a keyProvider. This PR provides opt-in flags and safe migration jobs to avoid disruption.

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Can we ensure the rotation controller honors pod disruption budgets for statefulsets? Requested change: add safe-drain logic.
Diego Morales (author): Updated controller to check PDBs and fall back to in-place certificate reload when PDBs prevent eviction. See controller change in a1c3f2b.
Lena Zhang: The Helm values schema should reject unknown keyProvider strings; added JSON schema validation. Approved after schema addition.
Marcus Lee: Concern about HSM connector secret bootstrap surface (exposes path to PKCS#11 library). Requested to document operator responsibilities and make the connector optional.
Diego Morales (author): Connector left optional; added examples and explicit warning in README. Added CI test that exercises the optional path with mock so library path is not required in CI.
Aisha Patel: Requested a migration dry-run mode for the rewrap job to list affected secrets without performing writes. Added --dry-run flag and unit tests.
release_notes: Automated TLS rotation and KMS/HSM integration for private deployments: adds rotation controller, Helm values for key providers, Terraform HSM/KMS modules, sealed-secrets/Vault migration helpers, and rollback tooling. Operators must opt in and grant KMS permissions. See docs/upgrade/rotation.md for migration steps.
upgrade_notes: Before enabling automated rotation, run installer/scripts/migrate_wrap_keys.sh --dry-run to preview keys that will be rewrapped. Ensure Terraform provisions KMS keys and that KMS IAM bindings allow encrypt/decrypt and sign where required. For HSM, deploy the connector and provide PKCS#11 config secrets via examples/hsm/pkcs11-bootstrap.yaml. Rollback via installer/scripts/rollback_pinned_certs.sh which retrieves pinned cert artifacts from the Terraform-managed encrypted storage bucket.
security_considerations: No plaintext private keys are written to logs. All wrapped keys are stored as sealed-secrets or in Vault. Audit events are emitted on rotation. Operators must ensure KMS IAM roles are restricted and HSM connector secrets are stored in a secure secrets manager. The migration job requires transient access to wrap keys; operators should run it from a secure bastion or CI with limited lifetime credentials.
testing_steps: 1) make dev-rotation (runs controller against dev Vault + mock pkcs11). 2) helm install charts/private-installer --set keyProvider=aws (or gcp/hsm) in staging. 3) run migration dry-run and confirm affected secrets. 4) enable rotation policy and verify rolling restarts occur according to policy. 5) run rollback script to validate restore path.
notes: This PR touches cross-cutting infra; ops and platform teams should review Terraform changes before applying in prod. The default remains opt-in to avoid accidental restarts. We've scheduled a follow-up to add metrics and tracing for rotation events (ENG-4201).
